kpis.name: UE SINR (SSB, UE side)
kpis.ref: UE log 'DL Chan: SSB SINR'; target = typical SINR for CQI 13 at 10 % BLER (link-level value, not 3GPP)
kpis.hint: Low SINR means noise or interference on the DL. In this bench the only source is the noise preset (AWGN on the UE receiver); check the DL channel buttons.

kpis.name: Average CQI
kpis.ref: gNB 'CSI [CQI n'; TS 38.214 5.2.2.1; target = baseline CQI - 2
kpis.hint: CQI follows SINR. A low CQI with a good SINR points to CSI-RS / CSI report configuration, not the channel.

kpis.name: Average DL MCS (seconds with data)
kpis.ref: gNB 'MCS (table) n'; TS 38.214 Table 5.1.3.1-1; target = baseline MCS - 4
kpis.hint: The scheduler picks the MCS from the CQI and lowers it further when the BLER is high. A low MCS with a good CQI points to the BLER-based backoff or an MCS limit in the gNB config.

kpis.name: DL HARQ retransmission rate
kpis.ref: OAI dlsch_rounds per RNTI; 38.214 BLER target 10 %
kpis.hint: Above 10 % the link adaptation does not follow the channel (MCS too high for the SINR).

kpis.name: DL user throughput (seconds with data)
kpis.ref: MAC goodput in seconds with data (>= 10 % of the baseline), simulated time; target = 80 % of the stage 3 baseline
kpis.hint: See the diagnosis above: it names the first link of SINR -> CQI -> MCS -> BLER -> throughput that fails.

kpis.name: UL HARQ retransmission rate
kpis.hint: UL decoding failures: PUSCH SNR too low for the UL MCS.

kpis.name: Time out of sync
kpis.ref: OAI in-sync / out-of-sync per RNTI, sampled once a second
kpis.hint: The gNB lost this UE: radio link failure follows.

kpis.name: Average RSRP (gNB report)
kpis.ref: rfsim has no path loss: RSRP stays near -41 dBm and does not show the noise preset

kpis.name: Power headroom (last report)
kpis.hint: Not used as a KPI: in rfsim the reported PH moves the wrong way (exp-power.sh).

diagnosis.summary: The gNB lost the UE (out of sync 0.6 % of the time): radio link failure. Check the noise preset and whether the UE pod restarted.
